headline: Datadog Shares Extend Losses Following Soft Revenue Guidance
summary: Datadog's stock continued its steep decline after the company failed to exceed expectations with its revenue forecast.
why: Datadog is a prominent cloud monitoring and security platform provider whose performance is closely watched as a barometer for enterprise software spending.

impacts.name: Datadog
impacts.why: Lower-than-expected revenue guidance directly caused downward pressure on the company's stock price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Disappointing revenue guidance directly triggered investor sell-offs, driving the stock price lower.
